question_summary: Subcontractor requests approval to substitute a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit in lieu of the specified packaged rooftop AHU per Section 23 05 00, citing lead time concerns.
proposed_solution: Use a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit in lieu of the specified packaged rooftop AHU.
routing_rationale: As a substitution request with no cost impact, it routes to the Mechanical Engineer as the design professional of record for HVAC equipment.
